def collapse_ints(nums: list[int]) -> str:
    """Sort distinct ints; write runs of 4+ consecutive as first-last."""
    vals = sorted(set(nums))
    parts: list[str] = []
    i, n = 0, len(vals)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and vals[j + 1] == vals[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        if j - i + 1 >= 4:
            a, b = vals[i], vals[j]
            fa = f"({a})" if a < 0 else str(a)
            fb = f"({b})" if b < 0 else str(b)
            parts.append(fa + "-" + fb)
        else:
            parts.extend(str(v) for v in vals[i:j + 1])
        i = j + 1
    return ",".join(parts)
